Draft a copy-paste prompt asking an LLM to label factor levels

draft_factor_labels_prompt.Rd

Collects the factor/logical variables in a DGF whose levels are still coded (label == level), and builds a self-contained prompt: the versioned factor-labels contract (see `inst/prompts/factor-labels-contract.md`) followed by each variable's name, label, description, and its `dd_f_levels` JSON. The LLM returns paste-ready JSON with human-readable labels. Useful when levels are decipherable but tedious to label by hand, or are a standard code system an LLM can look up (ISO currency, FIPS, NTEE, ...).

Usage

draft_factor_labels_prompt(
  dgf,
  vars = NULL,
  file = NULL,
  contract_path = NULL,
  quiet = FALSE
)

Arguments

dgf

A DGF data frame, or a path to a DGF `.xlsx` (read via [load_dgf()]) or `.csv` (read via [utils::read.csv()]).

vars

Optional character vector of `var_name`s to restrict to; default is all factor/logical variables with populated levels.

file

Output path for the prompt `.md`; `NULL` writes to `tempdir()`.

contract_path

Optional override for the bundled contract (path or URL).

quiet

If `TRUE`, only write the file (no console print).

Value

The prompt file path, invisibly. The prompt text is printed unless `quiet = TRUE`.

See also

[load_dgf()], [draft_detector_prompt()]
